Clara Persson  
San Francisco, CA | +1 (415) 555-0198 | clara.persson@nexaai.com | linkedin.com/in/clara-persson  

Professional Summary  
A seasoned machine learning engineer with 12 years of experience building scalable NLP systems and computer vision pipelines. Specialized in deploying production-grade models using PyTorch and TensorFlow, with a focus on reducing inference latency and improving model accuracy. Proven ability to translate research into real-world applications, including optimizing transformer-based architectures for customer support automation and enhancing image recognition systems for industrial quality control. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate MLOps practices, ensuring seamless model deployment across Kubernetes clusters.  

Technical Skills  
- **NLP**: Led development of transformer-based chatbots for customer support, achieving 28% reduction in response time. Built multilingual sentiment analysis pipelines using Hugging Face Transformers, improving classification accuracy by 19% for a global e-commerce client.  
- **Computer Vision**: Designed convolutional neural networks for defect detection in manufacturing, achieving 96% precision in real-time video streams. Integrated YOLOv5 models into existing systems, reducing false positives by 34%.  
- **Model Deployment**: Engineered end-to-end MLOps workflows for TensorFlow models, deploying 15+ models on AWS EC2 instances with 99.9% uptime. Automated model retraining schedules using Airflow, cutting manual intervention by 60%.  
- **PyTorch & TensorFlow**: Optimized PyTorch models for edge devices, achieving 40% lower latency without sacrificing accuracy. Built custom training pipelines for TensorFlow, reducing training time by 25% through distributed computing.  
- **Hugging Face Transformers**: Spearheaded migration of legacy NLP systems to Hugging Face’s inference API, cutting inference costs by 35%. Developed fine-tuning scripts for BERT variants, improving intent recognition F1 score by 12%.  
- **Kubernetes**: Orchestration of containerized ML workloads on GKE, scaling clusters to handle 10k+ concurrent requests. Automated rolling updates for production models, minimizing downtime during deployments.  
- **Docker**: Containerized ML workflows for reproducibility, reducing environment conflicts by 70%. Built custom Docker images for PyTorch and TensorFlow, streamlining CI/CD integration.  
- **REST API**: Designed scalable APIs for model inference, supporting 5k+ requests/second with Flask and FastAPI. Integrated Swagger documentation for internal teams, improving onboarding efficiency.  
- **AWS**: Deployed serverless architectures for NLP pipelines, leveraging Lambda and S3 for cost-effective scaling. Monitored model performance using CloudWatch, identifying 12% latency spikes in production.  
- **scikit-learn**: Built baseline models for A/B testing, achieving 15% improvement in classification metrics. Automated hyperparameter tuning with GridSearchCV, reducing manual experimentation time.
